signal.name: signal (shuffled-target control)
signal.reason_plain: Shuffling the historical answers barely worsened this model's error (x1.23, we require x1.50). That means the inputs carry little information about what happens next, so the model is tracking the typical level rather than anticipating events.
signal.corroboration: Confirmed with two further instruments (a decision tree and a random forest) in reports/sentinel_probe_study.md; all three agree.

overfitting.name: overfitting cap
overfitting.reason_plain: The model is not much better on data it trained on than on data it did not, so it has not memorised the history.
